frame: One plain round target board of five rings, no numbers, hangs on a plain wall at head height, seen from the front, with one plain dart in flight or landed. Only where the dart ends changes: in the centre ring, or in the wall beside the board.
sentence_nl: Zijn eerste worp is raak, maar de tweede is mis.
sentence_en: His first throw is on target, but the second one is off target.

frame: One child stands whole-figure in side view on a flat ground line, head tilted back, with one plain round ball and a plain wall behind, same figure size on the page. Only the ball changes: rising away from the child's hands, or dropping toward them.
sentence_nl: De ballon gaat omhoog, maar de bal gaat omlaag.
sentence_en: The balloon goes up, but the ball goes down.

frame: One plain small car seen from the side, front facing right, stands on a flat ground line between two identical plain posts, one near each edge, a plain low wall behind, same size in every drawing. Only the tyre tracks change: a short trail behind the boot, or ahead of the bonnet.
sentence_nl: Mijn auto rijdt vooruit, maar jouw auto rijdt achteruit.
sentence_en: My car is driving forward, but your car is reversing.

frame: A plain junction in a high three-quarter view from behind one adult: one path comes from the bottom edge and divides into three plain paths, one going straight ahead and one each to the left and right, with one small plain house beside the left branch. The adult stands at the foot of the junction, same size in every drawing. Only which branch carries a dotted route line changes.
sentence_nl: Eerst gaat u rechtdoor, dan gaat u linksaf en daarna rechtsaf.
sentence_en: First you go straight on, then you turn left and after that you turn right.

frame: Six identical plain wooden blocks lie on a plain table seen from the front, a plain wall behind, same block size on the page. Only the arrangement of the blocks changes: all gathered into one spot, or spread out one by one.
sentence_nl: De boeken liggen bij elkaar, maar het woordenboek ligt apart.
sentence_en: The books are lying together, but the dictionary is lying apart.

sentence_nl: Het licht ging plotseling uit, maar de zon ging geleidelijk onder.
sentence_en: The light went out suddenly, but the sun set gradually.

frame: Skipped set: on purpose and by accident (drawn in Vaste uitdrukkingen).
sentence_nl: Hij deed het expres, maar zij deed het per ongeluk.
sentence_en: He did it on purpose, but she did it by accident.
